instructions.name: accelerate_line
docs: Fires a pending acceleration once its notice has run: the line moves to collection, as with
`mark_in_collection`, without missed installments. Council only.

instructions.name: accept_council
docs: The proposed council signs and takes over, after the same multisig check as `init_pool`.

accounts.name: new_council
docs: The proposed authority: vault 0 of `multisig`, signing through Squads.

instructions.name: annotate_payment
docs: The council (the holder) attaches a receipt to payment entry `entry_count` of pagaré
`draw_index`, as a `Recibo` entry over `receipt_hash`. The annotation also replaces the pagaré's provisional `receipt_hash` until the burn (`PAGARE_PAID_PENDING_CANCEL`).

accounts.name: annotator
docs: The holder: the council while the asset is in the pool.

instructions.name: approve_line
docs: The council approves a requested line, naming its expediente root and terms hash, within 15
days of the request and within the line cap; a curator cannot be the borrower.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV the concentration cap is measured against.

instructions.name: cancel_line
docs: Cancels an `Approved` line nobody drew. Council only; refused once anything was drawn.

instructions.name: cancel_pagare
docs: Extinguishes pagaré `draw_index` once a repayment has marked it paid
(`PAGARE_PAID_PENDING_CANCEL`, whatever the line's status): writes the `Terminacion` entry,
then thaws and burns the asset; the record stays. The council (the owner), the procurador of
record alone, or the line's borrower alone once the cancel grace from the payment has run.
Never paused.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The council (the owner while the asset is in the pool), the procurador of record with a
procuración in force, or the line's borrower once the cancel grace has run; checked in the
handler (`NotHolder`, `ProcuracionState`, `CancelGraceNotElapsed`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receives the asset's rent from the Core program. Any signer.

accounts.name: pagare
docs: The record of pagaré `draw_index` of the line; written, never closed.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The Core asset the record names; burnt by the Core program.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' collection the asset belongs to.

accounts.name: procurador_authority
docs: The burn delegate's authority, `["procurador", pagare, holder]`: required on the
procurador's branch, where the program signs for it; left out on the owner's.

instructions.name: court_annotation
docs: Records a court's act on pagaré `draw_index`: `kind` is `KIND_ANOTACION_JUDICIAL` (embargo,
suspension, cancellation) or `KIND_CONSTANCIA_JUDICIAL`, over the court document's hash. The
council signs; refused on a cancelled pagaré; moves nothing.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the council while the asset is in the pool.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: The depositor pays `assets` for shares at the current NAV, at least `min_shares_out`; the
first deposit must meet the minimum and locks `DEAD_SHARES`. Refused while paused.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Pays a tranche of `amount_mxn` centavos to the borrower as USDC at the FIX in force, which the
borrower signs as `fx_rate` and `fx_date`, and mints the pagaré (its hash derived on chain
from the approved template and terms) as a frozen Core asset owned by the pool, with its
`Pagare` record. The borrower and the rent payer sign; refused while paused, once the draw
window has closed, on a changed or stale FIX, or above what the line, the vault or the pool cap
allows.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Signs alone: the signature covers the pagaré hash the program derives and the FIX.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the pagaré asset and its sidecar. Any signer.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The pagaré's Core asset, created here by the Core program. The client passes the bump so the
constraint does not search for it.

accounts.name: pagare
docs: The pagaré's record, created by the handler (Anchor's `init` would search for the bump).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' collection the pool controls (validated at `init_pool`).

instructions.name: endorse_pagare
docs: Endorses outstanding pagaré `draw_index` en procuración to `to`: appends the entry and lets
the program address `["procurador", pagare, to]` burn the asset through an owner-managed
`BurnDelegate`. The council (the holder) signs; `kind` must be `KIND_PROCURACION`; refused
with `to` the zero key, the pool, the council, a curator, the guardian or the borrower, or a
procuración in force.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the council while the asset is in the pool.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent the Core plugin may need. Any signer.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Creates the pool, its vault and its dead-shares account around `asset_mint`, the creator's
share mint and the series collection. The creator signs and pays; the council is vault 0 of
`multisig`, an autonomous Squads v4 multisig of at most ten members with a majority
threshold, and does not sign. Fixes the grace period and the line cap (`1..=10_000` bps of the
NAV) for the pool's life.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Pays for the pool and seeds its address; no other power.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022; `token_program` must be the mint's own program.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The share mint, created by the creator beforehand and validated here: mint authority = this
pool's PDA, supply 0, the asset's decimals, and no extension that takes or hides value.
`DefaultAccountState = Frozen` makes the shares permissioned.

accounts.name: vault
docs: A PDA token account, so nobody can pre-create it and block the pool.

accounts.name: dead_shares
docs: Holds the dead shares of the first deposit; nothing ever moves them. On a permissioned
share mint it is born frozen and must be thawed by the mint's freeze authority before the
first deposit (in this transaction or a later one).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection, created by the creator beforehand with the pool PDA as
update authority.

accounts.name: multisig
docs: The Squads v4 multisig whose vault 0 becomes the council; it does not sign here.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token program of `asset_mint` (classic SPL Token or Token-2022).

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The token program of `share_mint` (Token-2022 in production, under Token ACL).

instructions.name: mark_in_collection
docs: Moves a scheduled line to collection once `max_missed` installments are missed and the grace
period of the last of them has run, accelerating the balance. Anyone may call it, also while
paused.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pauses deposits, redemptions, requests, approvals and draws. Any member of the council'"'"'s multisig alone,
the guardian or the council; repayments and everything else go on.

accounts.name: signer
docs: A member of the council's multisig, the stored guardian, or the council itself.

instructions.name: post_fix
docs: Publishes Banxico's FIX: `fix_rate` is MXN per USD times 10^4, `fix_date` the date it was
determined (`yyyymmdd`). The feeder moves forward within 5%; the council publishes the rest.

accounts.name: poster
docs: The feeder or the council.

instructions.name: propose_acceleration
docs: Proposes to collect a drawn line early: draws are suspended at once and `accelerate_line`
may fire after the pool'"'"'s notice. Council only.

instructions.name: propose_council
docs: Names the next council: `kind` 0 (a Squads vault), the only kind taken. Council only, after
the multisig check; the zero key withdraws the proposal.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: The holder burns `shares` for assets at the current NAV, at least `min_assets_out`, up to
the vault's balance. Refused while paused.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: reject_line
docs: The council rejects a requested line; the rent returns to the payer.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Anyone pays up to `max_usdc` on an `Active` or `InCollection` line, credited in MXN at the FIX in
force (`fx_rate`, `fx_date`, whatever its age): late interest (which the credit must cover),
then interest, then principal, never more than is due; the USDC taken is rounded up. The remaining
accounts are exactly the pagaré records `[pagares_paid ..= last_touched]`, oldest first;
each one covered is marked paid with the payer's provisional `receipt_hash`. The line
becomes `Repaid` only when nothing is due and nothing can be drawn; while it can draw, a
payment on a zero debt is refused. Never paused.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may repay: the borrower, a sponsor paying the interest, or a third party.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

instructions.name: request_line
docs: The borrower requests line `line_id` (the pool's next) on terms `terms`, in centavos of MXN;
a separate payer funds the account and the named sponsor co-signs. Stored as `Requested` with
the terms hash; refused while paused. Moves no money.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the request and receives the rent back on withdraw or reject; never the borrower's
concern.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor named in the terms; required (and signing) when one is named.

instructions.name: resume
docs: Ends a pause. Council only.

instructions.name: resume_draws
docs: Reopens the draw window of a suspended line to its original end. Council only; refused while
an acceleration is pending.

instructions.name: revoke_procuracion
docs: Revokes the procuración in force on pagaré `draw_index`: appends the revocation entry over
the signed revocation's hash and returns the burn delegate to the owner. The holder (the
council) signs.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the council while the asset is in the pool. The owner alone revokes.

instructions.name: set_acceleration_notice
docs: Sets the acceleration notice, at least seven days. Council only.

instructions.name: set_cancel_grace
docs: Sets the wait from a pagaré's payment before its borrower may cancel it alone; never below
30 days. Council only.

instructions.name: set_collection_period
docs: Sets the seconds a line in collection waits, from its mark, before it can be written off.
Council only; refused below the 30-day floor.

instructions.name: set_fx_feeder
docs: Names the key that publishes the FIX (the zero key for none). Council only.

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: Sets the guardian, a key that may only pause (the zero key for none). Council only.

instructions.name: set_max_line_bps
docs: Sets the line cap, `1..=10_000` bps of the NAV at the approval. Council only.

instructions.name: set_outstanding_cap
docs: Sets the pool-wide cap on the USDC cost lent out. Council only.

instructions.name: suspend_draws
docs: Closes the draw window of an `Approved` or `Active` line now, forfeiting the undrawn
remainder. Council only. Repayment is untouched.

instructions.name: withdraw_acceleration
docs: Withdraws a pending acceleration; draws stay suspended. Council only.

instructions.name: withdraw_request
docs: The borrower withdraws a requested line, expired or not; the rent returns to the payer.

instructions.name: write_off
docs: Books a line's unpaid principal as a loss. Council only; an `Active` line after `term_end +
grace`, an `InCollection` line after its collection period from the mark and after its
oldest missed due date or its term, plus grace. Never paused.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV in the event.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: This signer may not do this

errors.name: SponsorRequired
errors.msg: The sponsor named on this line must sign

errors.name: NotHolder
errors.msg: The pagaré's holder must sign

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: The pool is paused

errors.name: CouncilInvalid
errors.msg: The council is not the vault of an autonomous Squads v4 multisig with a majority threshold

errors.name: CouncilTooLarge
errors.msg: The council multisig has more members than the program checks

errors.name: CouncilKindInvalid
errors.msg: This council kind is not accepted

errors.name: NoPendingCouncil
errors.msg: No council rotation is pending, or this signer is not the one proposed

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.msg: The council's decision is past its valid_until

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: Wrong mint or token account

errors.name: AssetMintNotAllowed

errors.name: ShareMintNotAllowed

errors.name: AssetNotListed

errors.name: AssetIsShareMint

errors.name: CollectionNotAllowed

errors.name: PagareAccountsMismatch

errors.name: BorrowerIsCouncil

errors.name: BorrowerIsCurator

errors.name: EndorseeInvalid

errors.name: WrongAmount

errors.name: Overflow

errors.name: InvariantBroken

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity

errors.name: ZeroShares

errors.name: FirstDepositTooSmall

errors.name: SlippageExceeded

errors.name: LineTooLarge

errors.name: OutstandingCapExceeded

errors.name: CollectionPeriodTooShort
errors.msg: The collection period is shorter than the minimum

errors.name: AccelerationNoticeTooShort
errors.msg: The acceleration notice is below the seven-day floor

errors.name: CancelGraceTooShort

errors.name: LineStatus
errors.msg: The line is not in the required status

errors.name: AgreementHashRequired
errors.msg: The signed agreement's hash is required

errors.name: ExpedienteRootRequired
errors.msg: The expediente root is required

errors.name: PagareTemplateHashRequired

errors.name: ExpedienteMismatch

errors.name: RequestExpired

errors.name: SponsorRoleInvalid

errors.name: TermEnded

errors.name: InvalidSchedule

errors.name: ScheduleEndsAfterTerm

errors.name: NotScheduled

errors.name: AvailabilityEnded

errors.name: TooManyDraws

errors.name: DrawsNotSuspended

errors.name: WindowClosed

errors.name: AccelerationState

errors.name: NotEnoughMissed

errors.name: TermNotEnded

errors.name: WriteOffTooEarly

errors.name: FixDateInvalid

errors.name: FixJump

errors.name: FixMismatch

errors.name: FixStale

errors.name: DocumentHashRequired

errors.name: SignatureMethodInvalid

errors.name: PagareNotCovered

errors.name: PagareAlreadyPaid

errors.name: CancelGraceNotElapsed

errors.name: EndosoKindInvalid

errors.name: AnnotationKindInvalid

errors.name: EntryNotFound

types.name: AccelerationProposed
docs: The council proposed to collect the line early; draws are suspended at once, and
`accelerate_line` may fire from `due_at`. The notice is addressed to the borrower.

types.name: AccelerationWithdrawn
docs: The proposal is withdrawn; draws stay suspended until `resume_draws`.

types.name: CollectionPeriodSet
docs: The pool's collection period after `set_collection_period`: seconds from the mark before a
line in collection can be written off.

types.name: CouncilProposed
docs: `council` must sign `accept_council` before it becomes the pool's council.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: Co-signed `request_line`; `None` when the line has no sponsor.

fields.name: sponsor_role
docs: `SPONSOR_PROMOTER` or `SPONSOR_GUARANTOR`; meaningful only when `sponsor` is named.

fields.name: agreement_hash
docs: Hash of the signed credit agreement.

fields.name: expediente_root
docs: Salted merkle root of the credit file in the agreements engine. A commitment: no document,
name or folio is derivable from it.

fields.name: principal
docs: The approved commitment; `available = principal - drawn`.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Annual ordinary interest rate, in basis points, charged on each tranche from its draw to
the last due date.

fields.name: term_end
docs: The maturity of a bullet line.

fields.name: availability_end
docs: Last instant a draw is accepted (strict `<`): `first_due_at` on a scheduled line,
`term_end` on a bullet line; `suspend_draws` brings it to now.

fields.name: drawn
docs: Principal transferred to the borrower so far; `drawn <= principal`, never decreases.

fields.name: draws
docs: Tranches drawn; at most `MAX_DRAWS`.

fields.name: interest_due
docs: Ordinary interest owed: each draw adds `amount * rate_bps * (last_due - now) / (BPS *
SECONDS_PER_YEAR)`; `mark_in_collection` cuts it to the share of the installments then due.

fields.name: pagares_paid
docs: The index of the oldest pagaré no repayment has marked paid. `repay` requires the records
`[pagares_paid ..= last_touched]` and moves it.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date; installment `k` is due at `first_due_at + (k - 1) * interval_seconds`.
Zero on a bullet line.

fields.name: installments
docs: Installments of the schedule, `1..=MAX_INSTALLMENTS`; zero on a bullet line.

fields.name: late_bps
docs: Annual late interest rate on the overdue principal, in basis points.

fields.name: max_missed
docs: Missed installments that allow `mark_in_collection`.

fields.name: late_paid_until
docs: Late interest is settled up to this instant; zero until a repayment collects some.

fields.name: drawn_at
docs: Time of the first draw; informational (the calendar is `first_due_at`).

fields.name: accelerated_at
docs: When `mark_in_collection` accelerated the balance; zero before. From then on every
installment is due, and `write_off` waits `Pool::collection_period_seconds` from it.

fields.name: currency
docs: ISO 4217 code of every amount of the line: `CURRENCY_MXN`.

fields.name: terms_hash
docs: `sha256` of the stored terms in the fixed encoding; the council's approval names it.

fields.name: pagare_template_hash
docs: Hash of the approved pagaré text every draw's pagaré hash is derived from.

fields.name: payer
docs: Funded the request; receives the rent back on withdraw, reject or expiry.

fields.name: draw_time_weight
docs: `Σ amount × drawn_at` over the draws: a bullet line's interest accrued at a mark is
`rate × (drawn × mark − draw_time_weight)`.

fields.name: availability_end_saved
docs: The `availability_end` before `suspend_draws` or `propose_acceleration` moved it, which
`resume_draws` restores; zero when draws are not suspended. Suspended ⇔ non-zero.

fields.name: acceleration_due_at
docs: When `accelerate_line` may fire, set by `propose_acceleration`; zero when none is pending.
`withdraw_acceleration` and `mark_in_collection` clear it, `accelerate_line` keeps it: with
`accelerated_at` it tells the route, the council's (non-zero) or the objective one (zero).

fields.name: usdc_drawn
docs: USDC delivered over the draws: the pool's cost of the line.

fields.name: usdc_cost_repaid
docs: The cost of the principal repaid, at each pagaré's own FIX; `usdc_drawn - usdc_cost_repaid`
is the cost still outstanding.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zero; for fields added after mainnet.

types.name: FixPosted
docs: A FIX publication: Banxico's rate for `fix_date` as published by `by` (the feeder or the
council) at `slot`. Each one can be checked against the DOF.

types.name: FxFeederSet
docs: The zero key means no feeder: only the council publishes.

types.name: FxRealized
docs: The FX result of one repayment's principal, in USDC base units: `cost` is the pool's cost of the
principal repaid (at each pagaré's FIX), `received` the USDC that paid it, `delta = received -
cost`. Emitted by `repay` before `LineRepaid`, with the same `receipt_hash`.

types.name: GuardianSet
docs: The zero key means no guardian.

types.name: InitPoolParams
docs: The `init_pool` parameters.

fields.name: grace_period_seconds
docs: Zero means no grace; fixed for the pool's life.

fields.name: max_line_bps
docs: `1..=BPS`; fixed for the pool's life.

fields.name: collection_period_seconds
docs: At least `MIN_COLLECTION_PERIOD_SECONDS`.

fields.name: guardian
docs: The zero key for none.

fields.name: max_outstanding_principal
docs: At least 1.

fields.name: acceleration_notice_seconds
docs: At least `MIN_ACCELERATION_NOTICE_SECONDS`.

fields.name: cancel_grace_seconds
docs: At least `MIN_CANCEL_GRACE_SECONDS`.

types.name: LateInterestCollected
docs: Late interest collected by a repayment of a scheduled line; it stays in the pool and raises
the NAV like interest. Emitted before the `LineRepaid` of the same repayment.

types.name: LineAccelerated
docs: The council accelerated the line after the notice: the same effect as `LineInCollection`,
without missed installments.

types.name: LineApproved
docs: The council approved exactly this expediente and these terms.

types.name: LineDrawn
docs: One tranche of `amount_mxn` centavos delivered as `usdc_delivered` at the FIX (`fx_rate`,
`fx_date`), and the line after it; `outstanding_after` is the pool's cost in USDC.

types.name: LineDrawsResumed
docs: Draws resumed with the window they had before the suspension.

types.name: LineDrawsSuspended
docs: `available_forfeited` is the undrawn remainder.

types.name: LineInCollection
docs: A scheduled line moved to collection and its balance accelerated. `remaining` is the principal
and interest still due after the acceleration, without late interest; `interest_forgiven` is
the ordinary interest of the installments not yet due at the mark, which the line no longer
owes.

types.name: LineRepaid
docs: A repayment: `principal_part` and `interest_part` in centavos of MXN, `usdc_received` the USDC
taken at `fx_rate`, `remaining` the MXN still due. Emitted after `FxRealized`, with the same
`receipt_hash`.

types.name: LineRequested
docs: Every term `request_line` stored, with the hash of their fixed encoding. On a bullet line the
schedule fields other than `late_bps` are zero; `payer` funded the request and gets its rent back.

types.name: LineTerms
docs: The terms of a line as `request_line` receives them.

fields.name: principal
docs: In centavos of `CURRENCY_MXN`.

fields.name: late_bps
docs: Annual late interest on the overdue principal, in basis points, scheduled or bullet.

types.name: LineWrittenOff
docs: The principal left in MXN (`loss`) and its cost in USDC (`loss_usdc`), which leaves the NAV.

types.name: NavUpdated
docs: The NAV and the share supply after every instruction that moves either (`deposit`, `redeem`,
`repay`, `write_off`), read back after the CPIs: `price per share = total_assets / share_supply`.

types.name: Pagare
docs: The program's record of one pagaré, beside the Core asset `draw` mints. It holds no folio and
nothing personal, and is never closed: after `cancel_pagare` it stays as the PAGADO mark.

fields.name: draw_index
docs: Which tranche of the line, 0-based.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Core asset at `[PAGARE_ASSET, line, draw_index]`.

fields.name: pagare_hash
docs: Hash of the signed pagaré data message, as `draw` received it.

fields.name: amount_mxn
docs: The tranche this pagaré documents, in centavos of MXN: the sum the pagaré promises.

fields.name: due_at
docs: The line's last due date at issuance.

fields.name: drawn_through
docs: The line's `drawn` after this tranche. Pagarés are covered oldest first, so pagaré k is
paid once the line's `principal_repaid` reaches it.

fields.name: cert_fingerprint
docs: `sha256(salt || fingerprint)` of the PSC or e.firma certificate that signed the pagaré text,
with the salt kept in the expediente: a bare fingerprint can be looked up to the signer's
RFC. Zero only when `signature_method` is `SIGNATURE_WALLET`.

fields.name: signature_method
docs: `SIGNATURE_*`.

fields.name: status
docs: `PAGARE_OUTSTANDING`, `PAGARE_PAID_PENDING_CANCEL` or `PAGARE_PAID`; never reverts.

fields.name: paid_at
docs: When the repayment that covered it landed; zero while outstanding.

fields.name: receipt_hash
docs: The receipt hash of that repayment: the payer's, until the holder annotates the real one
(`annotate_payment`, before the burn).

fields.name: cancel_receipt_hash
docs: The receipt hash `cancel_pagare` was given; zero until the burn.

fields.name: procurador
docs: The procurador of the endoso en procuración in force; the zero key when none. Cleared by
`revoke_procuracion` and by the extinction.

fields.name: flags
docs: `PAGARE_FLAG_*` bits.

fields.name: log_root
docs: The registry: `sha256(log_root || entry_hash)` over every entry, the issuance entry first.

fields.name: entry_count
docs: Entries in the chain; the issuance entry is 1.

fields.name: last_kind
docs: `KIND_*` of the last entry.

fields.name: fx_rate
docs: The FIX the borrower signed for this draw (`Pool::fix_rate` then) and its date.

fields.name: usdc_delivered
docs: USDC base units delivered: `fx::usdc_for_mxn(amount_mxn, fx_rate)`. The pool's cost of the
tranche.

fields.name: delivery_hash
docs: `sha256(pagare_hash || fx_rate || fx_date || usdc_delivered)`: the delivery the borrower
instructed, kept apart from the pagaré, which promises MXN only.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zero; for fields added after mainnet.

types.name: PagareCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_pagare`, before the burn. `holder` is the key that extinguished the pagaré
(the council, the procurador or the borrower); the sidecar stays as the PAGADO mark.

fields.name: by_borrower
docs: The borrower cancelled alone after the cancel grace.

types.name: PagareEntry
docs: One entry of a pagaré's registry: the full content the sidecar's hash chain commits to.
`stated_at` is the date the entry states and `recorded_at` the slot's time; every instruction
writes both as the slot's time.

types.name: PagareIssued
docs: Emitted by `draw` after `LineDrawn`: the pagaré issued as the Metaplex Core asset `asset`,
owned by `holder` (the pool PDA) and frozen. `due_at` is the line's last due date at issuance.

types.name: PagarePayment
docs: The payment entries of one `repay`: the payer's receipt hash (zero means "receipt
to follow"), the payment's split and one `PaymentEntry` per sidecar touched, oldest first.
Emitted after the `PagareEntry` of each entry.

types.name: PagareReceiptAnnotated
docs: A `Recibo` entry written by `annotate_payment`: the receipt attached to the payment entry
`payment_entry_count` of the pagaré's chain, as entry `entry_count`.

types.name: PaymentEntry
docs: One payment entry a `repay` wrote: the pagaré, the entry's kind (`Abono` or `Pagado`), its
position in that sidecar's chain, and the part of the payment's principal that fell on it.

fields.name: council
docs: The vault of the council multisig: signs every council instruction.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The share token mint; its mint authority is the pool PDA.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA token account `[VAULT, pool]` for `asset_mint`, owned by the pool PDA.

fields.name: dead_shares
docs: PDA share token account `[DEAD, pool]`, owned by the pool PDA; never burned.

fields.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection `draw` mints the pagaré assets into.

fields.name: outstanding_principal
docs: Principal drawn and neither repaid nor written off.

fields.name: interest_collected
docs: Ordinary interest repaid on every line; informative.

fields.name: written_off
docs: Principal written off on every line; informative.

fields.name: grace_period_seconds
docs: Seconds after a due date (or the term) before late interest accrues and collection or a
write-off is allowed; zero means none. Fixed at `init_pool`.

fields.name: collection_period_seconds
docs: Seconds from the mark (`CreditLine::accelerated_at`) before a line in collection can be
written off; at least `MIN_COLLECTION_PERIOD_SECONDS`. Set with `set_collection_period`.

fields.name: max_line_bps
docs: The largest line `approve_line` accepts, as a share of the NAV at the approval, in basis points
(`1..=BPS`). Set at `init_pool` and with `set_max_line_bps`.

fields.name: asset_controls
docs: `ASSET_CONTROL_*` bits: issuer controls of the asset mint that can stop the vault without
the program. Recorded at `init_pool`, never refused.

fields.name: permissioned
docs: The share mint is `DefaultAccountState = Frozen`: a holder's account must be thawed by the
mint's freeze authority before it can receive or burn shares. Recorded at `init_pool`.

fields.name: creator
docs: Paid for and seeds the pool; no other power.

fields.name: council_kind
docs: `COUNCIL_SQUADS` or `COUNCIL_GENERIC`.

fields.name: multisig
docs: The Squads multisig whose vault is the council; the zero key under `COUNCIL_GENERIC`.

fields.name: council_vault_bump
docs: The bump of the council's vault PDA `["multisig", multisig, "vault", 0]`.

fields.name: pending_council
docs: The authority `propose_council` named, until it signs `accept_council`; the zero key when
none.

fields.name: guardian
docs: A key that may only pause the pool, beside every council member; the zero key when none.

fields.name: max_outstanding_principal
docs: The most principal the pool lends at once, in asset units; checked at every draw.

fields.name: acceleration_notice_seconds
docs: Seconds from `propose_acceleration` before `accelerate_line`; at least
`MIN_ACCELERATION_NOTICE_SECONDS`. A proposal stores its own deadline.

fields.name: cancel_grace_seconds
docs: Seconds from a pagaré's payment before its borrower may cancel it alone; at least
`MIN_CANCEL_GRACE_SECONDS`.

fields.name: impaired_principal
docs: Principal of the lines in collection, for a provision at the mark; zero, not yet used.

fields.name: provision_bps
docs: The provision on `impaired_principal`, in basis points; zero, not yet used.

fields.name: fx_feeder
docs: The key that may publish the FIX within `fx::MAX_FIX_JUMP_BPS` of the last one; the zero key
when none (the council publishes). Set and rotated by the council.

fields.name: fix_rate
docs: The FIX in force: MXN per USD times `fx::FIX_SCALE`; zero before the first publication.

fields.name: fix_date
docs: The date Banxico determined `fix_rate`, `yyyymmdd`; never moves back.

fields.name: fx_realized
docs: The FX gain (positive) or loss realized by repayments, in USDC base units; informative.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zero; for fields added after mainnet.

types.name: PoolInitialized
docs: Every parameter `init_pool` recorded. `asset_controls` are the `ASSET_CONTROL_*` bits;
`permissioned`: the share mint is frozen by default.

fields.name: by
docs: The member, guardian or council that paused.

types.name: ScheduleParams
docs: Installment terms requested by `request_line`; fixed for the life of the line.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date (unix seconds), from the signed contract; must be after the opening.

fields.name: installments
docs: `drawn + interest_due` is paid in this many installments.

fields.name: max_missed
docs: Missed installments after which anyone may move the line to collection.
